summary: Theme testing complete - 'dark shell + light content surface' design system verified. Found and fixed critical bug: page titles (h1) were using light text color on light surfaces, making them invisible. Fixed 11 pages with missing text color styles.
passed_tests: ✅ Login page: Dark background (#0B0F14), light card surface (#F5F7FA), blue Sign In button (#2F8BFB)
✅ Login form: Dark text labels on light surface, inputs with proper borders (#CBD5E1)
✅ Dashboard: Dark sidebar (#111826), light content surface (#F5F7FA), stat cards visible
✅ Dashboard h1: Dark text (#0F172A) on light surface
✅ Customers page h1: Dark text on light surface (FIXED)
✅ Jobs page h1: Dark text on light surface (FIXED)
✅ Customer modal: Light background (#F5F7FA), dark text for title and labels (#0F172A)
✅ Sidebar: Dark shell with light text on dark, user info readable
✅ Sidebar flyout: Dark background with light text items
✅ Sign In button visible with proper blue color and white text
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Page titles (h1) in 11 pages were missing explicit text color, inheriting light-on-dark color from body
Root cause: body sets color: var(--text-on-dark) for dark surfaces, but content wrapper needed dark text
Solution: Added style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }} to h1 elements in affected pages
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme refactor fully tested. Dark shell + light content surface design confirmed working. Fixed invisible h1 titles bug in 11 pages. All colors verified: dark bg (#0B0F14), sidebar (#111826), light surfaces (#F5F7FA), dark text (#0F172A), accent blue (#2F8BFB).

bug_fixed.issue: Page titles (h1) invisible on light surfaces
bug_fixed.root_cause: body color set to var(--text-on-dark) but content areas use light surface background
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added inline style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }} to h1 elements
